definition.title: List Kujo abilities
definition.description: List the canonical Kujo Abilities exposed by the active local profile.

tool.name: kujo_ability_catalog
tool.description: List the Kujo capabilities currently available in Command Code, including effects and canonical identity.

definition.title: Inspect Ability receipts
definition.description: Read recent local Ability receipts for audit and run correlation.

tool.name: kujo_ability_receipts
tool.description: Inspect recent local Kujo execution receipts, including effects, policy, approval, run, and model identity.

definition.title: Inspect repository with Scout
definition.description: Generate a bounded, agent-readable Scout repository intelligence pack.

tool.name: kujo_scout_inspect
tool.description: Inspect a repository with canonical Kujo Scout and generate bounded context artifacts. Requires one-time approval because Scout writes a local report.

definition.title: Build Scent context pack
definition.description: Build a token-budgeted, redacted local context pack for agent handoff.

tool.name: kujo_scent_pack
tool.description: Build a canonical Kujo Scent context pack for a task. Supports dry-run; writes only after one-time approval.

definition.title: Summarize git changes
definition.description: Summarize the current git diff into a structured PatchBrief.

tool.name: kujo_patchbrief_summarize
tool.description: Use canonical Kujo PatchBrief to summarize changed files, risk, and review guidance.

definition.title: Measure change footprint
definition.description: Measure changed files, churn, categories, and blast-radius signals with ChangeBucket.

tool.name: kujo_changebucket_measure
tool.description: Measure a git change footprint and optional budgets with canonical Kujo ChangeBucket.

definition.title: Scan release readiness
definition.description: Run an informational ShipCheck release-readiness scan against a local repository.

tool.name: kujo_shipcheck_scan
tool.description: Run canonical Kujo ShipCheck and return its structured release-readiness report.

definition.title: Check architecture boundaries
definition.description: Check a repository against its Fence architecture policy.

tool.name: kujo_fence_check
tool.description: Run canonical Kujo Fence against the repository's architecture policy.

definition.title: Validate task contract
definition.description: Validate a Kujo Spec task contract without changing it.

tool.name: kujo_spec_validate
tool.description: Validate a .spec.yml, .spec.toml, or .spec.json contract with canonical Kujo Spec.

definition.title: Run Eval suite
definition.description: Execute a deterministic Kujo Eval suite and return structured verification evidence.

tool.name: kujo_eval_run
tool.description: Run a canonical Kujo Eval suite. Eval may execute configured commands and requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Report agent runs
definition.description: Render the local RunLedger record set for the selected repository.

tool.name: kujo_runledger_report
tool.description: Read and render canonical Kujo RunLedger receipts for local agent runs.

definition.title: Validate Dispatch workflow
definition.description: Validate a Dispatch workflow and explain configuration errors without running agents.

tool.name: kujo_dispatch_validate
tool.description: Validate a canonical Kujo Dispatch workflow without executing its agents.

definition.title: Query local Kujo RAG
definition.description: Query a locally installed Kujo RAG index and return citations.

tool.name: kujo_rag_query
tool.description: Query a local canonical Kujo RAG index. No Kujo-hosted service is used.

definition.title: Check local Watchdog
definition.description: Read health from an optional loopback-only Kujo Watchdog service.

tool.name: kujo_watchdog_health
tool.description: Check the optional local Kujo Watchdog service. Only loopback URLs are accepted.

definition.title: Scan artifact drift
definition.description: Scan repository documentation, examples, evaluations, and metadata for drift with Concord.

tool.name: kujo_concord_scan
tool.description: Run a read-only canonical Concord artifact-drift scan and return its JSON report.

definition.title: Capture failure evidence
definition.description: Create a redacted CaseFile evidence bundle from an existing local log file.

tool.name: kujo_casefile_capture
tool.description: Capture an existing failure log into a redacted canonical CaseFile bundle. Requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Run quiet workflow
definition.description: Run a repository-defined Muzzle workflow with bounded output and its safety policy.

tool.name: kujo_muzzle_run
tool.description: Run an allowlisted repository Muzzle workflow under enforced policy and bounded logging. Requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Validate Kennel project
definition.description: Validate the local Kennel manifest and dependency declarations without installing packages.

tool.name: kujo_kennel_validate
tool.description: Validate a local Kennel package manifest and dependency declarations.

definition.title: Install Kennel dependencies
definition.description: Resolve and install the dependencies declared by a local Kennel project.

tool.name: kujo_kennel_install
tool.description: Resolve and install Kennel dependencies. Mutable refs remain blocked unless explicitly requested; requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Run Dispatch workflow
definition.description: Execute a validated Dispatch workflow and retain its local run evidence.

tool.name: kujo_dispatch_run
tool.description: Execute a canonical Dispatch workflow non-interactively and retain run evidence. Requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Ingest local knowledge
definition.description: Ingest a bounded local path into the configured Kujo RAG namespace.

tool.name: kujo_rag_ingest
tool.description: Ingest local files into a canonical Kujo RAG namespace. Provider configuration may use external embeddings; requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Record Watchdog telemetry
definition.description: Submit one metadata-only correlated event to an optional loopback Kujo Watchdog service.

tool.name: kujo_watchdog_record
tool.description: Submit metadata-only session, run, agent, and tool correlation to loopback Watchdog. Requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Scan document for sensitive data
definition.description: Scan a bounded local text or Markdown document with a canonical Redact policy and retain a metadata-only audit run.

tool.name: kujo_redact_scan
tool.description: Scan a local .txt or .md document for sensitive data under a canonical policy and write a metadata-only audit. Requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Sanitize sensitive document
definition.description: Create a deterministic redacted copy of a bounded local text or Markdown document and verify the result.

tool.name: kujo_redact_sanitize
tool.description: Write and verify a sanitized copy using canonical Kujo Redact. Never stores raw detections; requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Validate VersionSeal records
definition.description: Validate the checksums and contracts in a local VersionSeal state directory without changing approvals.

tool.name: kujo_versionseal_validate
tool.description: Validate local VersionSeal record integrity. This tool cannot create, approve, reject, or revoke records.

definition.title: Validate agent pack
definition.description: Deterministically validate an existing PackWrite agent execution pack.

tool.name: kujo_packwrite_validate
tool.description: Validate an existing canonical PackWrite execution pack and return its JSON report.

definition.title: Summarize agent pack
definition.description: Summarize an existing PackWrite pack, including phases, missing files, warnings, and next action.

tool.name: kujo_packwrite_summary
tool.description: Read a canonical PackWrite execution pack summary without modifying it.

definition.title: Generate agent pack
definition.description: Generate and validate a PackWrite execution pack from a local mega-prompt through a configured provider.

tool.name: kujo_packwrite_init
tool.description: Generate and validate a PackWrite execution pack from a local prompt. Provider access and writes require one-time approval.

definition.title: Start RunLedger record
definition.description: Start a local RunLedger record for an agent run and capture its initial git state.

tool.name: kujo_runledger_start
tool.description: Start a canonical local RunLedger record and capture initial git state. Requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Finish RunLedger record
definition.description: Finalize a local RunLedger record with an explicit status and verdict.

tool.name: kujo_runledger_finish
tool.description: Finalize an existing RunLedger record with a caller-supplied status and verdict. Requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Validate decision proposal
definition.description: Validate a consequential decision proposal against Tribunal's bounded input contract without starting a hearing.

tool.name: kujo_tribunal_validate
tool.description: Validate a local decision proposal with canonical Kujo Tribunal without creating a hearing.

definition.title: Run offline decision hearing
definition.description: Run a deterministic credential-free Tribunal hearing and retain its sealed local decision evidence.

tool.name: kujo_tribunal_review
tool.description: Run a deterministic offline Tribunal hearing and retain decision evidence. Requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Validate evidence ledger
definition.description: Validate record contracts, checksums, and append-only events in a local Dossier state directory.

tool.name: kujo_dossier_validate
tool.description: Validate local canonical Dossier evidence records without modifying them.

definition.title: Report evidence ledger
definition.description: Read a bounded report of claims, sources, evidence, conflicts, quotations, consent, freshness, and rights records.

tool.name: kujo_dossier_report
tool.description: Read a bounded canonical Dossier evidence report without modifying its ledger.

definition.title: Validate showcase manifest
definition.description: Validate a Howl showcase manifest and every referenced example without rendering artifacts.

tool.name: kujo_howl_validate
tool.description: Validate a canonical Howl manifest and its referenced examples without writing output.

definition.title: Render showcase artifacts
definition.description: Render deterministic SVG, Markdown, or HTML showcase artifacts and a local gallery from a Howl manifest.

tool.name: kujo_howl_render
tool.description: Render deterministic canonical Howl showcase artifacts. Requires one-time approval.

definition.title: Validate browser flow
definition.description: Validate a Lens browser flow's structure and safety constraints without launching a browser.

tool.name: kujo_lens_flow_validate
tool.description: Validate a canonical Lens browser flow without launching a browser or writing artifacts.

definition.title: Check rendered page
definition.description: Open a local or explicitly allowed external page in a real browser and retain deterministic Lens QA evidence.

tool.name: kujo_lens_check
tool.description: Run canonical Lens in a real browser and retain QA evidence. External URLs require an explicit flag; execution requires one-time approval.
